Mark the provided projects as paused.

Sets spec.paused in the manifest of each named project. Paused projects are left alone by slipway fetch and slipway sync, which run no git command in them; slipway rollout undo still acts on them. Use slipway rollout resume to resume a paused project.

Examples:
  # Keep fetch and sync away from project dots
  slipway rollout pause dots

Usage:
  slipway rollout pause (NAME... | project/NAME...) [flags]

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
